identification: Six bottles of Casella 1919 Shiraz 2007, 14%, in the plain white 'Casella 1919 / 2007 Shiraz / 14%' label seen on Grays 'Cleanskin' releases of the same wine (Casella Family Brands, Yenda NSW). The retail 1919 Shiraz 2007 was a ~$90-100 premium release, but the plain label here matches the cleanskin (surplus, unbranded-price) version, which sells far cheaper at auction. Photo shows a Wynns carton behind, not the original case. Fill levels look into the neck; corks not visible.
